reason: My paid work comes through my agency guy and the Bengaluru food creators WhatsApp group, and that already works for me. Free is nice, but I don't see a reason to set up a new app when my manager already screens offers for me.
objection: If the café is paying Mitra a fee on top, they'll just offer me less to cover it, so 'keep your whole fee' sounds good on paper but the fee itself shrinks. And I don't know if any businesses near me are actually on it yet.
would_change_my_mind: Someone in my WhatsApp group posting that they got a real paid invite from a Bengaluru café through Mitra at a fee as good as what the agency gets me.
